source: tools/g6/deck.py over tools/g6/brayton.py and tools/thermo/nasa.py (NASA TM-4513 polynomials, complete Jet-A combustion)

basis.eta_c: COMPUTED: the top of the brief band 0.70-0.78, needed for PR 4.2 inside the 460 m/s tip-speed limit with 12+12 radial blades (Wiesner slip 0.892, tip 457 m/s)
basis.eta_t: COMPUTED choice for an uncooled single axial stage of this size
basis.eta_t_rdc: eta_t minus 2 points for unsteady inflow (brief section 1.4)
basis.guide_vane_loss: MEASURED: Welsh et al. rigs, as charged by the brief
basis.TIT_K: COMPUTED choice for uncooled cast nickel blades

humphrey_measured_rdc.rdc_source: MEASURED: best equivalent-available-pressure gain -6.84% (Tesla-valve inlet RDE, Experimental Thermal and Fluid Science 2023, sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0894177723000651), which surveys -8% as the best earlier result; a Michigan axial-inlet RDC measured at best a 20% total-pressure loss (deepblue.lib.umich.edu)

humphrey_simulated_rdc.basis: PROJECTED: Frolov et al. H2-air simulations, +11 to +14%
PROJECTED: Frolov et al. H2-air simulations, +11 to +14%

refusal.computed: 1.193 lb/lbf/h with the best measured RDC pressure gain (-6.84%) and the 5% guide-vane loss; the Brayton baseline gives 1.102
refusal.physics: the deck closes 1.05 only with a net RDC equivalent-available-pressure gain of 10.5% at TIT 1150 K; every measured RDC pressure gain found is negative
